close_hint: X closes the panel; collection continues in the tray.
incident_hint: Select a record to view its charts.
view_hint: Charts: 10 min; lines retain min/max. A candidate is not a cause.
help_cpu_cores: Utilization and clock rates of individual CPU cores.
help_disks: Disk read/write latency and queue length.
help_process_io: Read and write activity of individual processes.
help_window_response: Response time of the foreground window to a system query.
help_frames: Present and DWM events via ETW. Requires PID and process ancestry.
help_gpu: Graphics adapter activity and power state.
help_gpu_details: NVIDIA temperature, clocks and power via NVML. Sleeping GPUs are left asleep.
help_dpc: CPU time spent in DPC and hardware interrupt routines (ISR).
help_dpc_events: Long DPC/ISR events and associated drivers via Kernel ETW.
help_boot: Process CPU and I/O during the first minutes after sign-in.
reason_etw_permissions: Windows denied ETW access. Run the recorder as administrator or grant trace recording rights.
reason_etw: ETW did not start or has no events yet. See the technical error below in Details.
reason_gpu: Windows or the driver is not providing GPU data.
reason_nvml: Requires NVIDIA, NVML and an awake adapter. Sleeping GPUs are not queried.
reason_boot: Collected only during the initial period after sign-in.
reason_missing: No data yet: startup, a locked session, or an unavailable system counter.
analysis_delay_detected: A delay was measured. Its cause is not established.
analysis_resource_alert: Resource warning detected; responsiveness may be affected.
analysis_no_delay: These measurements do not confirm a delay.
incident_no_samples: This recording contains no chart data.
incident_unreadable: Could not read this recording. Select another incident.
queue_full: The recording queue is full. Collection continues; some data was skipped.
disk_reserve: Not enough free disk space to save data. Collection continues in bounded memory.
write_failed: Could not save some data. Collection continues. See source details.
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed. See source details.
hotkey_unavailable: The bookmark shortcut is in use or unavailable.
tray_unavailable: Waiting for the Windows notification area. The icon will be retried.
pdh_initializing: System counters are starting. CPU and memory collection continues.
pdh_slow: A system counter responded too slowly. Late measurements were skipped.
invalid_budget: History limit must be a number from 1 to 100,000 MB.
invalid_retention: Enter a valid number of hours for history retention.
invalid_settings: These settings are outside the supported range.

report_boot_note: Already running at observation start. Short-lived processes may have no measured peaks.
report_technical_note: `null` means unavailable. Present/DWM work is not confirmed display scan-out latency. Page Reads/sec counts disk reads for hard faults; per-process page faults also include soft faults. Recent PnP power state does not prove D3cold.
linux_pressure_help: CPU: some tasks waiting. Memory and I/O: all non-idle tasks stalled. This does not prove a visible freeze.
linux_platform_source: This Windows source has no equivalent available in this Linux session.
linux_initializing_or_unavailable: Waiting for counters, or the source is unavailable. Check permissions and kernel support.
linux_gpu_partial: Activity covers accessible DRM clients; other processes may be missing.
linux_gpu_power_guard: Sensors are read only for confirmed active GPUs with recent activity.
linux_tray_unavailable: This desktop does not provide a StatusNotifierItem tray host.
linux_shortcut_unavailable: The shortcut is unavailable, already reserved, or its portal permission was not granted.
relative_time: Relative time from the start of MangoHud logging; not aligned to system incidents.
